notes.title: Update Notes for April 24, 2025
notes.content:
Fixes since the last update: 

 - Updated abilities that target random enemies - Hits will now always land on enemies (at random per the ability) and will not "miss." The number of hits will also correspond to the number of hits indicated by the ability description. For example, a 3 hit random-target ability may hit 3 enemies out of a battle against 4 of them, or it may alternatively hit one enemy twice (so, 2x the damage) and another enemy once. As another example, if there is 1 enemy left in the battle, a 3-hit random-target ability will hit that enemy all three times (ie 3x the damage of a single hit).

 - Fixed sound effect volume setting - it wasn't adjusting a few battle effects and some UI effects, and now does
 - Fixed some spacing issues affecting some dialogue lines
 - Fixed a minor sprite clipping issue in the castle town
 - Fixed a spot that players could get stuck on overworld
 - Minor balancing adjustments
 - Some minor optimization tweaks
 - Put another failsafe in to help ensure Chat achievement activates

notes.title: Update Notes for February 26, 2025
notes.content:
Fixes since the last update notes:
 - Fixed Solar Flare, where in some cases it was inaccessible from the menu
 - Actions no longer occur while Escaping
 - Fix: rapidly tapping confirm on one unite no longer lets you access a second unite for a given character in a round
 - Can no longer buy already-equipped items in Final shop
 - Accessing Main Menu while over Save point fixed
 - Can access Quit menu when standing over shops or saves
 - Fixed a showing decimal for Fire Flurry+ A
 - Dragon Doll 2 missing in save file fixed
 - Some minor cursor movement fixes (where cursor would show when it was or wasn't supposed to)
 - Fix: Can now access Lita's Comp Virus when backing out of the menu and back to it again
 - Fixed UI overlay issue where some background elements would show over portraits
 - Adjust SMG damage
 - Adjust enemy XP, mainly in later areas, to smooth level-up curve
 - Fix various typos

notes.title: Update Notes for Jan. 16, 2025
notes.content:
Here are the fixes/tweaks that are now live since the last Update Notes post:

 - Fixed collision/sticking point in southwestern part of World map
 - Fixed some stat boosts (such as to MP or HP) for various equipment
 - Tweak: Battles won't occur just outside towns/dungeon entrances (avoids battles occurring during map transition from World Map)
 - Fix: Laser Gun wasn't piercing/ignoring defense in some battles
 - Fixed display of some stat boosts that weren't showing in Status/Equip
 - Fixed Dem's Fire Flurry+A, where it was requiring 12MP when should be 10MP
 - Fixed some erroneous dialogue messages popping up early
 - Fixed certain situations where gaps appear in ability lists, and some overwritten abilities
 - Reduced frequency of "warning" dialogue in Dragonduck Lair
 - In certain scenarios some NPCs could "walk away" during dialogue, this is fixed
 - Fixed some ability descriptions during Level-Up, and some in battle
 - Fixed some cursor movements in battle
 - Fixed instances where the player could "run away" right at the end of story dialogue. This also fixes the potential 'sequence break' when encountering the Usurper/King initially.
 - Fixed Sara LV22 level-up paths
 - Fixed Junk Monster boss battle where it wasn't rebuilding its allies if they were defeated by Rain of Fire

Thank you!

edit: I had "2024" on the title instead of 2025. It's a new year, oop!

notes.title: Some bug fixes - Update Notes for December 20
notes.content:
Bug fix update:
 - Blessing ability no longer overwritten by Hailstorm/Snowstorm
 - Level-up reward for Dem at Level 21 is fixed (where it would repeat previous choices in certain circumstances)
 - Sandstorm+ works now
 - Certain passives, such as Flow, that weren't properly carrying over to later battles should now work
 - Mirror Shield subtracts correct price from Gold on purchase
 - Vit stat for Mirror Shield in shop turns white when you have Mirror Shield equipped (instead of green)
 - In rare instances, NPCs that could cause a soft lock in Paladennus should be fixed; you can also open the main menu during most town NPC dialogue boxes if necessary
 - Health Ring for Sara now properly grants +50 HP
 - Fixed double-appearing dialogue for Naya NPC in the library
 - In rare cases save points may not register your choice, but you can enter the Main Menu from there to avoid getting "stuck"
 - some minor tweaks that may help with loading initial battles

Some of the fixes unfortunately won't be retroactive to existing save files, mostly the ones affecting an ability or passive.

notes.title: Update for December 14, 2024
notes.content:
- Fixed problem where players who tried to use Fight command in areas with no available immediate battles (usually when first entering a new area) will now display a message that there are no battles available. This also fixes the "black screen" issue some players noticed in these areas while using Fight.
 - Adjusted trigger for achievements Commence Battle and Buddy Banty so they more reliably activate.
 - Fixed a bug in a specific spot that could potentially get the player 'out of bounds'
